players.product: Chromium single-cell and Atera spatial biology platforms

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings release (8-K exhibit): 10x Genomics raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $610 million to $630 million from the previous range of $600 million to $625 million; excluding the non-recurring license and royalty revenue related to patent litigation settlements in both 2026 and 2025, this represents 2% to 5% growth over full year 2025. Gross margin rose to 74% from 72%, primarily due to lower manufacturing costs, which included $2.6 million of tariff refunds, and lower inventory write-downs. CEO Serge Saxonov: 'The story of the quarter was the extraordinary customer response to Atera. We are highly encouraged by the engagement across the research ecosystem and the very strong early order flow.'
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue guidance $610 million-$630 million (previously $600 million-$625 million); 2% to 5% growth ex settlements; $2.6 million tariff refunds
